MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Alexa-compatible cameras feel like useful additions to my recent Echo setup: they offer home monitoring I could access through devices I already use.",
    "The microSD card connects with my past storage and card-reader purchases, although I would first confirm that a device I intend to use supports its capacity."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire HD keyboard requires a particular tablet I have not shown that I own; my recent keyboard purchase was for Mac or Windows.",
    "The drawing display assumes a creative activity I have not expressed, while the car adapter and dash cam assume a current driving-related need that my old GPS purchase does not establish.",
    "The separate photo frame feels unnecessary before I explore photo display on my recently added Echo Show, and neither the specialized battery charger nor the desk fan addresses a need I currently recognize."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying computer accessories does not mean every USB or Bluetooth product is useful to me; it needs to work with equipment I own and serve a clear purpose.",
    "My older GPS and remote-battery purchases seem to have been stretched into broader interest in car electronics and battery equipment, even though those purchases met specific needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Echo purchases make useful Alexa connections especially relevant, which is why the cameras appeal more than unrelated electronics.",
    "What I already own matters: a new item should add a useful capability rather than duplicate my Echo Show or require an unconfirmed tablet, phone, or car setup.",
    "Storage capacity and device compatibility matter more to me than simply getting a larger card."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in practical electronics, but fit best when they extend my current devices and meet a clear need."
}
